answer: Fake identities multiply stake and burn costs linearly, while genuine agents recover value through attested work. Agents stake a bonded ivory deposit tied to a verified plume signature history before joining the economy; each epoch they must burn a small ember fee proportional to their claimed activity. An attacker creating N sybils pays N times the deposit plus N times the ember burn, making large-volume identity farming economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
